daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are hitting different today, Aries. You're radiating that main character energy—trust it. The universe is basically handing you permission to be authentically, unapologetically you. Lean into it.
daily.love: Someone's picking up on your frequency, whether you realize it or not. If you're coupled up, your partner's feeling the shift in your aura. Single? The stars suggest being open to unexpected conversations. Chemistry doesn't always announce itself.
daily.career: Your ideas are sharper than usual—this is the day to pitch, propose, or speak up in meetings. Don't dim your light for anyone. Your confidence isn't arrogance; it's just you finally matching the energy the universe has been sending.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement today. Whether it's dancing, walking, or stretching, let yourself feel alive in whatever way calls to you. Rest isn't lazy; it's strategic. Listen to what your energy actually needs.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is all about authenticity, Aries. You're being called to lean into what actually matters to you, not what you think should matter. Trust that gut feeling—it's your superpower right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a softness asking to come through. Let yourself be a little vulnerable with someone you trust. Real connection > surface level vibes, always.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different this week. Don't sleep on that creative project or way of doing things that feels unconventional. The energy supports you taking up space and being heard.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for presence, not punishment. Moving in ways that feel good—not what TikTok says you should do—is where the healing is at. Listen to what actually brings you joy.
